selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What two ideas does the passage say the truth of mercifulness proves?
questions.answer: It proves divine unity and also oneness shown within that unity.

questions.question: How is mercy described in relation to all things?
questions.answer: It is presented as something that reaches everything and includes all beings.

questions.question: Which living beings receive this nurturing mercy according to the passage?
questions.answer: All animate beings receive it, especially those that have just entered worldly life.

questions.question: What qualities mark the way this nurturing is carried out?
questions.answer: It is done with great order, precision, and consistency.

questions.question: What does the passage say happens to the needs of living beings?
questions.answer: Their needs are delivered to them, and none of them are left out.

questions.question: What does the passage imply by saying mercy reaches all individuals at the same instant?
questions.answer: It implies a power and control that are not limited by place, number, or timing.

questions.question: How does the passage connect regular care for creatures with belief in one Creator?
questions.answer: It treats that universal and simultaneous care as evidence that one Lord manages all life.

questions.question: What comparison is made between the truth of opening and the truth of mercifulness?
questions.answer: Both are said to point clearly to unity: one through the ordered shaping of beings, and the other through the ordered care and provision given to living creatures.

questions.question: At the end of the passage, what did the traveler witness next?
questions.answer: He witnessed the Third Truth at the Third Stopping-Place.

questions.question: What transition does the final sentence make?
questions.answer: It moves from the second truth to the traveler’s witnessing of the third truth.

questions.question: In this passage, what is the main role of mercifulness?
questions.answer: It cares for living beings by sustaining them and meeting their needs.

questions.question: Does the passage present mercy as limited to a few creatures or spread across creation? Explain.
questions.answer: It presents mercy as spread across all creation, reaching every animate being.

questions.question: What feature of this mercy shows that it is not random?
questions.answer: It operates in an orderly and regular way.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the treatment of beings that are new to life?
questions.answer: It says they are especially nurtured and provided for with careful attention.

questions.question: How does the passage rule out neglect in divine care?
questions.answer: It says no individual is overlooked.

questions.question: What is the significance of mercy reaching all individuals everywhere at one time?
questions.answer: It shows universal command and presence over all creatures at once.

questions.question: What larger belief does this universal mercy support?
questions.answer: It supports belief in the unity and oneness of Allah.

questions.question: How is the truth of mercifulness similar to the truth of opening?
questions.answer: Both function as signs that point to one divine source behind creation and care.

questions.question: How is the truth of mercifulness different from the truth of opening in focus?
questions.answer: Opening focuses on the ordered formation of beings, while mercifulness focuses on nourishing and sustaining living beings.

questions.question: What does the traveler’s next step in the passage show about the structure of the work?
questions.answer: It shows the work is organized as a journey through successive truths or stopping-places.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the formation of all beings under the truth of opening?
questions.answer: Their forms are made and unfolded in a regular and orderly way.

questions.question: Why is that important in the argument of the passage?
questions.answer: Because such order is taken as strong evidence of divine unity.

questions.question: What is the central claim made about the truth of mercifulness?
questions.answer: Its all-encompassing care for living things also points to divine unity and oneness.

questions.question: Which category of beings is the passage mainly concerned with under mercifulness?
questions.answer: It is mainly concerned with animate beings.
